title: Transient R2 Config+Plugin Relay Delivery Contract
description: SSOT JSON-Schema (draft 2020-12) for the Cloudflare R2 transient config+secret+plugin relay (cf-r2-relay-config-secret-delivery). The control plane stages a freshly-provisioned workspace's {config.yaml + prompts/* + secret files + system-prompt.md} AND its RESOLVED plugin trees as ONE transient R2 object, injects a short-TTL single-object presigned HTTPS GET into the box env, and DELETES the object the moment the box acks provision-ready. The box holds NO durable cloud credential — only the minutes-long presigned URL. This contract pins the box-facing env keys, the bundle wire-shape, the integrity+fail-closed contract, the plugin drop namespace + presign declared-scheme (so config AND plugins ride ONE channel), and the ready-ack endpoint. Producers: CP internal/configrelay (Stage/InjectEnv/DeleteOnReady) + internal/pluginresolve (server-side plugin resolution). Consumers: molecule_runtime.config_relay (fetch/verify/unpack/ack) + molecule_runtime.plugin_sources (presign provider). INVARIANT: the integrity digest is verified fail-closed (a mismatch ABORTS boot) and the object is deleted on ack — a secret bundle never persists.

relay_uri_env.description: Env key carrying the short-TTL (~10m) single-object presigned HTTPS GET. Its PRESENCE is the box-side enable gate (no separate runtime flag).

relay_sha256_env.description: Env key carrying the sha256 hex of the RAW bundle body. The box verifies before unpack; a mismatch is fail-closed.

relay_ack_token_env.description: Env key carrying the one-time ready-ack bearer. Only sha256(token) is stored server-side.

cp_url_env.description: Existing CP base-URL env the box derives the ack endpoint from (the relay env carries only the token, not a URL).

bundle_shape.description: The transient object body: a JSON object mapping a config-path-relative path to base64 of its bytes. Marshaled via the SAME provisioner.ValidateAndMarshalConfigBundle path/charset/base64 validation as the legacy Secrets-Manager bundle, so the box has ONE unpack path.

path_charset.description: Every bundle path must match this charset and must not escape the config path (no absolute, no ..). Validated on WRITE (CP) and re-validated on UNPACK (box).

integrity.description: The digest algorithm over the raw bundle body.

fail_closed.description: A fetch failure after the retry ceiling OR a sha256 mismatch ABORTS boot (SystemExit) — the box never boots on incomplete/tampered config.

plugin_drop_prefix.description: Bundle namespace for RESOLVED plugin trees (config-path-relative): .relay-plugins/<name>/<relpath>. Disjoint from config/prompt paths, so a plugin can never shadow a secret. The box unpacks it here; a presign://<name> declared source resolves it from here.

plugin_declared_scheme.description: The declared-plugin scheme for a relay-delivered tree: presign://<name>. Resolves to <config_path>/.relay-plugins/<name>/ — NO network, NO box-held plugin credential. A gitea://<owner>/<repo> source the CP could NOT resolve server-side is left verbatim for the box's own fetcher (fail-soft).

plugin_declared_env.description: Comma-joined declared-plugin sources. The CP rewrites each source it resolves server-side to presign://<name>; unresolved/non-gitea sources are left verbatim.

ack.description: The provider-agnostic ready-ack the box POSTs once /configs is written and the platform is serving. Best-effort on the box (a permanent ack failure only logs; the CP ReapAbandoned sweep + R2 lifecycle rule are the delete backstops).

delete_on_ack.description: A successful ack DELETES the transient R2 object (idempotent). The secret+config+plugin bundle never persists in the relay.
